source: Refine quick employee tabs, validation, and dependent forms

assumptions.text: At least one employee tab remains at all times; closing the active tab selects the nearest remaining employee.
Validation appears only after field blur, tab switching, adding another employee, or attempting the final action.
Parent and in-law dependent options stay disabled until the GMC secondary plan is enabled.
Prefill Data also fills any dependent records already added to each employee.
Basic information, insurance plans, and dependents are sibling FieldSet sections inside one Compass Card separated by Separator components.
Employee Tabs live inside the form Card and each tab has an adjacent Compass icon Button for removal.
The summary footer is sticky on tablet and desktop but static on mobile to avoid obscuring form fields.
Incomplete touched sections use the existing destructive Badge and Alert variants; untouched sections remain neutral.
